policy.scope: CI/runtime warning governance for pytest + smoke logs; project shim deprecations are allowed only when documented in deprecation_warnings_v1.json

allowlist.name: contracts-schema-field-pydantic-v2
allowlist.message_regex: ^Field name "schema" in "[^"]+" shadows an attribute in parent "BaseModel"$
allowlist.escalation: tracked in T34 compat backlog: rename 'schema' field to 'schema_version' across all contracts in packages/contracts/ in a dedicated API-contract-change PR; until then, field is documented here as a known Pydantic v2 naming conflict
allowlist.notes: packages/contracts/ response models define a 'schema' field for response-type identification (e.g. 'genomeai.api.alerts.list.v1'). Pydantic v2 considers 'schema' a reserved BaseModel attribute name. Surfaced once web smoke completed successfully in T34 Postgres cutover. No behavior change — warning only. Fix requires renaming field and updating all consumers.

allowlist.name: python-multipart-known-issue
allowlist.escalation: review in a separate dependency-only change; validate pytest + smoke + verify_refactor before changing runtime dependency versions
allowlist.notes: Documented historical external warning. Current target baseline is zero occurrences.

allowlist.name: ddtrace-known-issue
allowlist.escalation: treat as separate dependency/pytest-plugin investigation; do not mix with business refactor
allowlist.notes: Documented monitoring-only issue. Current target baseline is zero occurrences.

denylist.name: project-runtime-warning
denylist.escalation: fix in project code before merge; runtime/future warnings from project code are not accepted in CI

denylist.name: project-user-warning
denylist.escalation: either remove the warning or explicitly document/allowlist it in a separate compatibility change

denylist.name: unknown-origin-warning
denylist.escalation: normalize filename/origin classification or document the warning source before accepting it
